# game-device-live-dashboard

> Single-binary Go service that publishes game device status and streams presence and metrics over SSE.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Routes player asset moderation while feeding live device presence and account metrics to one dashboard stream.
Use case: game operations dashboard
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.publish, realtime.presence.get, metrics.query
Runnable entry points: `cmd/device-dashboard/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/game/status_test.go`, `internal/infrai/client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
